posts.author: Theponidraws
posts.body:
Since we're making some fixes to our demo game, we decided to adjust a few elements, including the message window, which we felt was too large. To do this, we used the YEP_MessageCore plugin and changed the "Default Rows" parameter from 4 to 3. However, this caused an issue where the face sets are now too big for the text box and don’t automatically resize.
Is it possible to adjust this directly in RPG Maker or we’ll need to manually resize the face sets, which would require more work?

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
I think you can leave some blank for the face image.
And edit face indent in yep to move the text slightly toward the left to fit the new position.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
for static use, resize it smaller to 90x90 or 100x100 what suits.
than use a mini plugin or drop it inside any plugin you use and add
those 2 lines on top or bottom.
JavaScript:
Window_Base._faceWidth  = 144;
Window_Base._faceHeight = 144;
change value based on face width/height and should do the trick.
